_howto: Life at AKH (About page section #life-at-akh and the Careers strip). Add one object to 'moments' per team activity, celebration, learning session or achievement, using approved content only. type: team | celebration | learning | achievement. date: YYYY-MM-DD. images: one or more { src, alt, pos } (put photos in website/images/life/, about 1600px wide, WebP, under 250 KB; they are cropped to 16:9, use pos e.g. '50% 30%' to keep faces in view). link is optional (an article on this site, e.g. blog/<slug>.html or news/<slug>.html). Set placeholder to false for real moments: a pillar with no real moments is hidden, and the whole section stays hidden until at least one exists. 'storiesAsAchievements': true also lists every story in events.json under Achievements.
